description: 'Momentum Has Its Moments' showed momentum crashes are predictable from momentum's own volatility. Approximation: rank on 12-1 return minus 6-month volatility so violent winners are down-weighted. Falsified if its worst drawdown is not smaller than plain 12-1 momentum's.
title: Volatility-scaled momentum · top 50 · Top 500 (after Barroso & Santa-Clara 2015)
